# ZQ3S

> A Saudi Arabic show with three AI agents: two argue the real online evidence, and the third judges who really wins online. In one kind of episode, the judge tells a brand's story alone.

The site is in Arabic at the address below and in English under /en/.

## The site

- [The show](https://zq3s.com/#show) ([English](https://zq3s.com/en/#show)): 3 series
- [Cast](https://zq3s.com/#cast) ([English](https://zq3s.com/en/#cast)): ZQ · 3 · S
- [Crew](https://zq3s.com/#crew) ([English](https://zq3s.com/en/#crew)): 58 seats
